title: Flash backup 10.11 - U7's reset (pin 35) and where to hold it
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (229 px/mm, full resolution)
caption: Pin 35 (RESET_N) runs left and down to the top pad of the tan 0402 part (2), `likely` its reset capacitor to GND. Held to GND there, U7 stays in reset and lets go of the serial lines it shares with the Wi-Fi chip. Beep first: 1 to 2 beeps, 3 to GND beeps, 2 to 3V3 must NOT beep.

callouts.label: RESET_N
callouts.note: Pin 35 (SWRS204C p. 9: no internal pull-up), the 11th pin of the left row from the top, 2nd from the bottom (picture 10.1). Its trace leaves the toe up-left, then runs down to 2.

callouts.label: the hold point: GND probe here
callouts.note: The pad pin 35's trace ends on (mosaic). Beep to pin 35 first, and check it does NOT beep to 3V3 (U15 pin 8). Then a GND probe here, before power, as on TP33.

callouts.label: the other pad: GND?
callouts.note: If it beeps to GND, the part is the reset capacitor and 2 is safe to hold low.

callouts.label: not this one (pin 36's trace)
callouts.note: Pin 36's (DIO_23) trace runs down to its top pad (mosaic).
